Zepbound cost
Zepbound may cost $25 for a 1-month or 3-month pen prescription if you have commercial insurance and are eligible for the Savings Card. Note that patients with government insurance (Medicare, Medicaid) are not eligible for the savings card. Through the Zepbound self-pay program, tirzepatide is available directly to patients as a 4-count single-dose vial or single-patient-use KwikPen. All six doses are available: 2.5 mg ($299), 5 mg ($399), 7.5 mg ($499), 10 mg ($699), 12.5 mg ($699), and 15 mg ($699) per month. The list price of Zepbound is $499–$1,086.37 per fill, but this is not what most people pay.
Refer to our Zepbound price guide for more information, or see " How much is Zepbound with or without insurance? " and " What is the Zepbound Coupon or Savings Card? "
